app_type: React Native Expo Mobile App (hybrid_fullstack, expo-router)
target_audience: Worship leaders, musicians, and church members managing schedules, repertoire, and communication.
core_vibe: Warm, welcoming, organized, peaceful, and professional.

design_principles.fusion_over_imitation: Mix modern SaaS utility with warm, editorial-style church bulletins. Data should feel like an invitation, not a spreadsheet.
design_principles.emotion_first: The UI should reduce anxiety for volunteers. Use calming colors and soft spacing.
design_principles.zoom_in: Highlight the most immediate action (e.g., 'Sua próxima escala' - Your next scheduled service) largely and clearly.
design_principles.negative_space: Use excessive padding (p-6, p-8) to let dense information (songs, keys, scales) breathe.
design_principles.contrast: Deep olive typography against warm off-white backgrounds ensures high readability while staying soft.

font_families.mono: JetBrains Mono, monospace (for music chords/cifras only)

layout_and_spacing.bottom_nav: bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-xl border-t border-[#EBE8DF] pb-safe pt-3 px-6 rounded-t-3xl shadow-[0_-4px_24px_rgba(0,0,0,0.03)]
layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Use NativeWind/Tailwind spacing: gap-4 for lists, gap-8 between sections.

login_hero_bg.description: Cinematic warm photograph of an acoustic guitar on a church stage. Use for the login/signup screen background with a dark gradient overlay.

abstract_peaceful_bg.description: Soft off-white and gold gradient. Use for empty states, profile headers, or as a subtle background behind the main dashboard.

worship_team_1.description: Woman playing guitar. Good for a community post or ministry group banner.

worship_team_2.description: Outdoor serene scene with a guitar and bible. Good for devotionals or retreat announcements.

buttons.primary: bg-primary_olive text-white rounded-full px-6 py-4 font-medium flex items-center justify-center active:scale-95 transition-transform
buttons.secondary: bg-surface_elevated text-primary_olive rounded-full px-6 py-4 font-medium flex items-center justify-center border border-subtle

inputs.text: bg-white border border-[#EBE8DF] rounded-2xl px-4 py-4 text-primary text-base placeholder:text-disabled focus:border-primary_olive focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary_olive

lists.scale_item: flex flex-row items-center p-4 bg-white rounded-2xl border border-subtle mb-3
lists.repertoire_item: flex flex-row justify-between items-center p-4 border-b border-subtle last:border-0

tabs.tab_active: bg-white rounded-full shadow-sm py-2 px-4 flex-1 items-center justify-center
tabs.tab_inactive: py-2 px-4 flex-1 items-center justify-center text-secondary

testing_requirements.data_testid_rule: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
testing_requirements.convention: kebab-case, role-based. E.g., data-testid='login-button', data-testid='scale-item-12', data-testid='nav-repertoire'

dashboard_layout.hero_card: Next Scale (Próxima Escala) - Prominent card with date, time, and role. CTA: 'Ver detalhes'
dashboard_layout.quick_actions: Row of icons: Add Song, New Scale, Announcements
dashboard_layout.recent_announcements: Horizontal scroll or vertical list of recent feed items.

scales_layout.view: Month/Week toggle. List of upcoming services.
scales_layout.card_details: Date, Time, Event Name. List of assigned musicians with micro-avatars.

repertoire_layout.search: Prominent search bar with filter by Key (Tom) or BPM.
repertoire_layout.list: Song Title, Artist, Key badge. Tap to open Lyrics/Chords (Cifra) view with monospace font.

instructions_to_main_agent: This is an Expo React Native application using expo-router. Use NativeWind for Tailwind styling. Do NOT use Shadcn/UI for React DOM, you must use React Native compatible components.
Always apply the generous spacing rules (e.g., p-6) to avoid cluttered mobile views.
Ensure the music repertoire section uses JetBrains Mono or a system monospace font for rendering 'cifras' (chords) correctly above lyrics.
Apply `data-testid` properties to every Pressable, TouchableOpacity, TextInput, and significant View for testing.
Use the provided media URLs for the login background and placeholder images.
